summary: Authenticated iFood agent workflows keep session state in the browser and use deterministic local quote and cart-plan validation before any cart write.
reason: The private web API depends on browser-owned session material and anti-bot state that must not be exported into public artifacts or agent output.
validated_outcome: Browser planning, quote validation, and confirmation-gated cart planning remain deterministic while credentials stay in the signed-in browser session; dry-run validates parameters without requiring an observation file.
